records.summary: Corrected the earlier interpretation of raRVLN. XRPLWin confirms the account as an AMM pool, but its Vault and Loan Broker sections did not load ledger objects or provide IDs. Current ledger-backed amendment pages show LendingProtocol at 19/35 and SingleAssetVault at 21/35, both below the 29/35 (>80%) threshold held for 14 days. XRPL Dashboard says both must activate before native lending goes live. Therefore the prior vault/loan-broker association is downgraded to unverified; the 20M XRP movement is not evidence of native lending collateral.
